body:
GRAMMAR.md written per NORTHSTAR.md's phased plan: exact lexical token table (codepoints + variation-selector matching rule closing the emoji-tokenization-ambiguity gap), EBNF grammar, precedence/associativity, vector/matrix/row-extraction shapes, GROUP capture-group non-nesting fix. Re-derived 3 source-doc examples; one surfaces a genuine gap in the source's own casual example. Explicitly deferred items named (truthiness, unchecked-MATMUL, let-lowering blowup, loops/error-handling, EQ glyph identity). No lexer/parser code -- grammar only. LO commit f2ae276.
